_note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for usage windows, reserve/drain policy, and reset anchors. NO reset time is hardcoded in prose. Per-seat drain policy: `drain` = full (drain freely) | reserve (hold headroom for the intake/dispatch job); `reserve_pct` = the reserve line (a SOFT preference that YIELDS as a last resort — a reserve seat is still USABLE, so self-imposed caps never strand real capacity); `intake` = this seat backs dispatch/intake and holds headroom by policy; `billing` = included (subscription token — maximize) | metered (real API $ — drain LAST). This local layout is ONE EXAMPLE of a complicated setup; the engine scales 1→N via MB_CONFIG_DIR. Null anchors mean 'owner has not set this yet'; bin/usage-record.py --learn-windows can infer them from observed resets. Edit ONLY this file when a window/policy changes.
limit_determination_order: 1. hard machine signal: a real 429 / usage-limit recorded into usage-ledger.json (seat spent until reset)
2. computed/learned window: usage-status rolls the anchor forward to the next reset instant
3. owner/manual %: a number the owner notes in usage-ledger.json (fallback only)
LLM estimation of remaining quota is not a source.
